contract.metric: Geometric mean of allocation-inclusive public API latency over the entire fixed matrix; paired baseline/current ratio controls between-run drift.
contract.constraints: Strict native dispatch; original reference pools one; optional four-worker confirmation separate; numerical, layout, dtype/tag, warning parity before timing; no local builds/tests overlap measurement.
